description: This file defines the `Template` class responsible for managing the rendering of HTML templates using the Plates engine within the Daux documentation generator. It includes methods for initializing the template engine, registering custom functions, and rendering templates with dynamic data, as well as constructing navigation elements.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Handles loading, customizing, and rendering HTML templates with navigation and localization support within the Daux static documentation generator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Template object with a global configuration.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the current Plates Engine instance, configuring template directories based on user settings or defaults.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a specified template with provided data, injecting global config data into the template context.

methods.name: registerFunctions
methods.description: Registers custom functions available within templates for navigation, translation, and breadcrumb title generation.

methods.name: renderNavigation
methods.description: Recursively builds HTML markup for navigation menus.

methods.name: buildNavigation
methods.description: Constructs a navigation structure from a directory tree.

methods.name: getSeparator
methods.description: Returns a separator string based on configuration, used in breadcrumb generation.
